description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git pack-objects command with sparse and non-sparse algorithms. It sets up a repository, creates various commit scenarios, and verifies the correctness of the pack-objects command output under different options and configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the test repository.
